positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• JavaScript, Express, NodeJS, React, Redux
• Flutter, Dart, Android / IOS
• GCP, Google Cloud Platforms
• Firebase Firestore, Storage, Authentication 
• AWS, Elastic Search

For this role I am developing software for a web application that services various businesses in Oregon and around the United States. These applications dispatch their employees from HQ in real time through the Cloud, handles scheduling, and coordinates administration. I am also developing UI interfaces and real-time Cloud functionality for mobile applications using Flutter.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description: Volunteer for maintaining Web Applications with Technical Projects Coordinator

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Building functional SPA forms with React to post to database
• Rendering data API to front-end React Application
• Created custom search filter for UI database interaction.
• JavaScript, React, Google API, Google Firebase, Airtable

For this role I helped lead a project on developing a way to generate and share Resources and Events for the CHANGED community.  I created a React SPA applications and integrated it into their SquareSpace website.  I helped setup a database and generate REST API calls for the app to function.  I also developed a way for their team to filter through the data and choose what to show on the website by an approval process.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• JavaScript
• C# , .NET
• React ,  Angular
• MySQL , PostgreSQL , MongoDB , NoSQL
• Agile Methodologies
• AWS Deployment
• Web Security

I helped mentor and tutor students while engaged in a full stack certification role with Bethel School of Technology.  I  collaborated on a team project and developed a unique stack, Java -  React - MySQL and Node.js.  I offered other students new and creative ways to gain experience including internships with other companies.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Laravel and Vue.js
• PHP, JavaScript, REST API integration
• Firefox Extension and Chrome Extension development

For this position I learned and implemented some advanced OOP Techniques on the stack's backend.  I helped create an interface that updates and stores information on REST APIs regarding attributes and endpoints in Vue.js for the application's integrations team.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
• Tasked to troubleshoot and resolve Network and Computer issues for clubs throughout the U.S. remotely for headquarters located in Carlsbad, Ca
• Cisco Networking
• Remote Networking Solutions
• Dameware, IP configs, Password Resets
• Problem Solving

For this role I worked with a small team at the Headquarters for 24 Hour Fitness and helped solve complex network solutions remotely for every club in the U.S.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Application:  https://www.basicesl.com
Company:  https://www.bilingualdictionaries.com
• Front End Web Engineer
• Data and Content Management
• Front End Design , UI / UX
• Adobe Photoshop
• Joomla CMS

I helped integrate a C# / .NET application into a JOOMLA CMS front end.  I developed the UI Interface with custom designs and graphics (Photoshop).  I also worked on integrating and managing content from Bilingual Dictionaries ESL course into the application.  I helped with changes to the AI Voice Speech software as well.
